This walk is one of several through the project. The website of the first, [babykev, shown one move at a time](../), lists them all.

The first lecture walks through babykev on its branch `main`, from `step-00` to `step-05b`. Each step is one
commit, with no moves between the steps. The tutorial, on the branch `tutorial`, builds the same project again
one move at a time.

Each page is one part. A part is one or more changes to the project, each a section of its page. The code where a part starts and where it ends has a tag on GitHub, such as `step-00`, or is a commit between two tags. The top of each page says where its part starts, and the bottom says where it ends, each with a link to that code.

Each part ends with a section called **What changed**. It lists every file that the part changes, with a link to the file, and then the whole diff of each file, folded. A lockfile and a binary file have a link alone. The text above it explains the change.
